assessment: This study provides novel evidence that a dopamine D2/D3 receptor antagonist enhances model-based control of behavior, whereas blocking opioid receptors has no effect. These conclusions are based on compelling behavioral and computational modeling data. The paper makes an important contribution to our understanding of how dopamine shifts the balance between two subsystems regulating behavior and may improve the understanding of motivational dysfunctions in mental disorders like addiction.
